question: Add a new required field BatchConfig BatchSettings to the storageExporter struct. This exporter is the bridge between OTel Collector pipeline and Jaeger storage backends. OTel contrib components that wrap or test this exporter will break.

primary_change.description: The storageExporter struct is defined here (line 19-24) with fields: config *Config, logger *zap.Logger, traceWriter tracestore.Writer, sanitizer sanitizer.Func. Adding a required BatchConfig BatchSettings field here is the source change. The newExporter() function (line 26-31) constructs the struct and would need to initialize the new field.

directly_affected_files.reason: Creates storageExporter struct literals directly at lines 74-78 and 93-97 without the new BatchConfig field. These test functions (TestExporterStartBadNameError, TestExporterStartBadSpanstoreError) construct &storageExporter{config: &Config{...}} which would need the new required field.

The createTracesExporter function at line 41 calls newExporter(cfg, set.TelemetrySettings) which constructs the storageExporter struct. The newExporter function signature and body would need updating to handle the new BatchConfig field.

Tests createTracesExporter and createDefaultConfig which indirectly construct storageExporter via newExporter. If BatchConfig validation is added, tests creating Config without BatchConfig would fail.

The Config struct would likely need a corresponding BatchConfig/BatchSettings configuration field so users can configure it via the OTel Collector config, and the Validate() function may need updating.

indirectly_affected_files.reason: Imports storageexporter.NewFactory() at line 39 and registers it as an exporter factory. While this file won't have a compile error (it only calls NewFactory()), the Jaeger binary that bundles OTel contrib components (jaegerreceiver, kafkareceiver, kafkaexporter, spanmetricsconnector, etc.) would be affected if CI/integration tests fail.

The storagetest.NewStorageHost() utility from otel-collector-contrib is used in Jaeger's exporter_test.go (lines 71, 87, 191) to create mock hosts for testing the storageExporter. While storagetest itself won't break, any otel-contrib CI that runs Jaeger integration tests using this utility would fail.
